verdict.rationale: CIPO's own public pages offer keyless database searches. Patent databases can be searched and office records downloaded, and the trademarks page lists an Advanced search, so a founder can look up their filing in public records. The evidence never says these searches show application or case status, and the patents path otherwise runs through a MyCIPO account login. Missing for 10: explicit documentation that public search shows filing, application or case status; trademark status lookup details; independent or hands-on corroboration.

support.subject: As a founder, I can look up the status of my filing, application, or case from the service's public pages
